title: Legacy Archive Compliance Analysis
business: Legal firms managing massive, multi-year document repositories.
problem: Firms struggle to perform deep semantic analysis on legacy document sets exceeding 500,000 words due to context window limitations in older tooling, leading to incomplete discovery.
solution: Utilizing the 1M token context window of Claude Opus 4.8 allows for the ingestion of entire legal case files in a single pass, enabling comprehensive cross-referencing of evidence that was previously fragmented.
steps: Aggregate legacy case documents into a single serialized text stream.
Initialize the API request using the claude-opus-4-8 model ID.
Leverage the 1M token context window to load the full repository.
Apply adaptive thinking to synthesize complex legal arguments across the entire corpus.
Extract findings using the synchronous Messages API within the 128K output limit.
outcome: A unified, context-aware summary of legacy litigation history that maintains internal consistency across disparate document sources.
limitation: Claude Opus 4.8 is a legacy model with a knowledge cutoff of January 2026; users must verify if recent legal precedents or regulatory changes post-dating this cutoff impact the analysis.
